 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. title: Oracle PAAS Admin Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle PAAS Admin \- Consultant, Managed Services**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations maximize value from enterprise technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As a Cloud Technical Consultant within Managed Services, you will support clients in maintaining, enhancing, and optimizing cloud\-based solutions that enable business performance and operational continuity. Deloitte’s practitioners bring together technology experience, process knowledge, and delivery discipline to help organizations address complex operational needs, improve system performance, and support ongoing transformation in a dynamic business environment.
   

  

 Level: Consultant or equivalent
   

  

 As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As an Consultant, Managed Services on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Support Oracle Cloud technical operations across managed services engagements, including issue analysis, defect resolution, and system enhancements.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, extensions, and data conversion components using Structured Query Language (SQL), BI Publisher, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, Financial Reporting Studio, and File\-Based Data Import templates.
* Support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle Service\-Oriented Architecture Cloud, Representational State Transfer services, Simple Object Access Protocol services, and Web Services Description Language\-based services.
* Perform production support activities, including queue monitoring, ticket updates, incident and problem management, and resolution within service\-level requirements.
* Collaborate with functional and technical teams across delivery locations to support deployments, code migrations, testing, and ongoing system improvements.


**The team**
 Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.
   

  

 The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 24x7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or Information Systems.
* 3\-6 years of experience in Oracle Middleware, Oracle Fusion administration, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or Oracle Platform as a Service administration.
* Experience configuring or administering Oracle Platform as a Service tools, including Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle Service\-Oriented Architecture Cloud, Visual Builder, Oracle API Gateway, Autonomous Transaction Processing, Autonomous Data Warehouse, or Oracle Database Cloud Service.
* Experience configuring or supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services, including Virtual Cloud Networks, subnets, Identity and Access Management policies, platform monitoring, and access controls.
* Experience provisioning, patching, upgrading, or maintaining cloud environments across development, testing, and production stages.
* Experience automating administrative tasks with Terraform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Command Line Interface, Linux or Unix shell scripting, or Python.
* Experience troubleshooting cloud environment errors, managing Oracle Service Requests, or supporting application deployments and connectivity setup.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024 Foundations Associate certification, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Certified Associate certification, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Certified Professional certification.


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

* SAP marketplace management (S\-user account creation, OSS connection, diagnosis etc.)
* Conduct/coordinate DRP drill with outsourcer
* Support for internal/external audit

* Authorization Troubleshooting: Conduct L2 analysis on user authorization failures and security\-oriented issues raised by the business.

* SAP user creation/modification
* SAP user lock/unlock
* User role assignment
* Segregation of duty audit(LSF)


**SAP project support**
* Support Valeo SAP projects in addition to application maintenance


**Other**
* Strong communication skills to lead and drive drive topics independently
* Monthly dashboard reporting
* Vendor (infrastructure outsourcing) communication and support SAP infrastructure related activities


**Skills**
* Business Criticality Mindset: Maintain a structured approach to assessing incidents by evaluating their impact on supply chain and operational continuity; prioritize troubleshooting for bottlenecks or IDoc failures based on their urgency to the business.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Exceptional communication skills to gather requirements from business users, translate them into technical briefs, and coordinate efficiently with external outsourcers for L3 fixes.
* Analytical Thinking: A structured approach to preliminary incident analysis—knowing exactly when to apply an application\-level fix and when to escalate to the infrastructure outsourcer.

title: Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**About Workhall** 




 Workhall is a bootstrapped low\-code / no\-code enterprise workflow platform. We help large organisations model complex operations as configurable data structures, workflows, and reports, without the cost and drag of bespoke custom development. Today we serve 20\+ enterprise customers across India, Australia, and the Americas, in industries ranging from manufacturing, food and beverage, construction, trade, and private capital.
 



**About the role** 




 You will be the technical backbone that turns the Workhall platform into a working enterprise application. Sitting inside the professional services team, you own requirements gathering, solution design, solve the hard data\-modelling and integration problems that complex customers bring, and act as the deep technical reference point for our implementation partners.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on solutioning role for someone who is equally comfortable whiteboarding an architecture and configuring the platform themselves. You are not just advising from the sidelines. You design, you build, and you set the standard others follow.
 



**What you will do** 





 Solution design and architecture
 



* Own end\-to\-end solution design on the platform: datalists, workflows, roles and permissions, reports, and the expression logic that ties them together.
* Translate ambiguous enterprise requirements into robust, scalable, maintainable configurations rather than one\-off hacks.
* Make and defend data\-modelling decisions, including denormalization and relationship patterns, with an eye on performance and long\-term maintainability on a document\-database platform.




 Build and delivery
 



* Configure and build complex applications.
* Design and implement integrations between Workhall and external enterprise systems.
* Own the hardest technical parts of an implementation, and unblock delivery teams when they hit the limits of the platform or the data model.




 Customer and stakeholder engagement
 



* Run technical discovery workshops with enterprise customers, shape the application, and communicate trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor through an implementation, from design through go\-live and stabilisation.




 Partner enablement and quality
 



* Enable, review, and raise the quality bar for implementation partners so delivery stays consistent as we scale.
* Define reusable patterns, templates, and technical standards that the wider delivery ecosystem can adopt.




 What we are looking for
 



* Experience. 3 to 6 years in enterprise software implementation, solution consulting, or technical delivery, including meaningful time on low\-code / no\-code, BPM, or workflow automation platforms.
* Data modelling. Strong data\-modelling instincts and comfort with document or NoSQL databases; MongoDB experience is a clear advantage.
* Platform depth. Ability to reason about workflow logic, conditional expressions, and integrations from first principles, not just by copying prior examples.
* Communication. Customer\-facing maturity: you can run a workshop, defend a design decision, manage expectations, and say no well.
* Ownership. A track record of owning the technically hardest part of a project and getting it live.




 Nice to have
 



* Familiarity with LCNC platform, API design, scripting, or integration middleware.




 Why join us
 



* Ownership. Real ownership. We are a lean, bootstrapped team, so your work ships and your judgement counts from week one.
* Depth. Hard, interesting problems. Modelling messy enterprise operations into clean, reusable software is genuinely difficult and genuinely rewarding.
* Range. Breadth of exposure. You will work across regulated industries and global markets, not a single narrow use case.
* Leverage. A platform with leverage. What you build once serves many customers and many verticals.

title: Global Data Steward
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100\+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
 We are seeking an experienced and detail‑oriented Global Data Steward to join our team in Chennai, India, supporting WPP Media’s global Master Data Management (MDM) initiative.
   

  

 This role plays a critical part in maintaining the integrity of WPP Media’s Golden Master Data assets across domains such as Clients, Media, Suppliers, and other core business entities. The role works hands‑on with AI‑assisted mastering and mapping in our internally developed MDM platform, Matrix.
   

  

 The role requires strong ownership, sound judgement, and an attitude focused on getting it right — not just getting it approved. The Global Data Steward is expected to actively drive data quality outcomes, challenge poor inputs or AI recommendations, and ensure that master data decisions are correct, intentional, and fit for long‑term enterprise use.
   

  

 As a Global Data Steward, you will work cross‑region with markets, finance teams, and global stakeholders. A structured, proactive, and assertive (“pushy when needed”) approach is essential to ensure mappings are completed, standards are met, and nothing critical stalls.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
* Review, validate, and approve AI‑generated mapping recommendations using WPP Media’s internal Matrix MDM tool.
* Apply strong judgement to ensure AI recommendations:
+ Correctly represent real‑world business entities.
+ Do not introduce duplication, fragmentation, or incorrect hierarchies.
+ Follow agreed global standards, naming conventions, and data models.

* Assess and approve new master data additions to the Golden List across multiple domains (e.g. Client, Media, Supplier).
* Actively drive and push local, market, and finance teams to:
+ Complete required mappings.
+ Resolve unclear or missing information.
+ Correct poor‑quality or inconsistent submissions.

* Challenge, reject, or return mappings and requests where data is incomplete, incorrect, or poorly justified.
* Take ownership of end‑to‑end stewardship flow, ensuring items do not stall in queues or wait indefinitely for market action.
* Provide structured feedback into Matrix to improve AI‑assisted mastering and stewardship efficiency over time.
* Serve as a guardian of data quality, consistency, and enterprise usability of master data.
* Collaborate closely with Local Data Stewards, Finance, Product, and Platform teams to ensure alignment on standards and expectations.
* Enforce and uphold data governance principles, approval workflows, and escalation paths.
* Escalate complex, disputed, or model‑level issues to the appropriate governance forum when required.
* Ensure all stewardship decisions are clearly documented, auditable, and transparent.


**What you'll need:**
* Experience in Master Data Management, data stewardship, data governance, or data quality roles, ideally in a global or multi‑market organization.
* Strong understanding of master data concepts including golden records, canonical entities, hierarchies, and deduplication.
* Experience working with MDM tools and approval workflows (experience with internally built tools is an advantage).
* Comfortable reviewing and challenging AI‑assisted or rule‑based mappings (no ML development required).
* Highly structured, organized, and comfortable pushing stakeholders to meet data quality and completion standards.
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to think long‑term and cross‑domain.
* Confident in saying “no”, “not yet”, or “this needs fixing” when quality is at risk.
* Clear communicator, able to interact effectively with business, finance, and technical teams.
* Experience operating within formal governance and decision‑authority models is a strong advantage.


**Additional Competencies We Strongly Recommend For This Role**
 Data Governance \& Control
   

  

* Understanding of stewardship layers (local vs global), decision authority, and escalation models.
* Appreciation for auditability, traceability, and consistency over speed.


 Stakeholder \& Execution Drive
   

  

* Comfortable chasing, reminding, and escalating when markets or teams do not complete required mappings.
* Able to balance collaboration with firmness to keep the master data agenda moving.


 Cross‑Domain Stewardship
   

  

* Ability to apply the same quality bar across multiple master data domains, not just one.


 Operational Ownership Mindset
   

  

* Sees stewardship as active ownership, not a review inbox.


 Proactively prevents backlogs, rework, and downstream impact.
   

  

**Who you are:**
**You're open
 *:***
 we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open\-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
   

  

**You're optimistic
 *:***
 we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
   

  

**You're extraordinary:** 
 We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
   

  

**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people** 
 – we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
   

  

**Scale and opportunity** 
 – we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
   

  

**Challenging and stimulating work** 
 – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.
   

  

**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**
**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**
**Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp\-privacy\-policy\-for\-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.**

description:
**Position Overview**
 Citi is seeking an experienced, high\-caliber Database Technical Lead (C13 / VP) to lead the design, modernization, administration, and resiliency engineering of enterprise database platforms. As a C13 Database Lead, you will be responsible for defining technical strategies, driving cloud and database\-as\-a\-service (DBaaS) transformations, ensuring strict data governance and security compliance, and leading senior technical engineers across critical multi\-region banking systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Requirements**
* Enterprise Database Architecture \& Technical Strategy Architect, design, and deliver end\-to\-end database solutions across relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) and NoSQL/Distributed databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis). Define enterprise standards for data modeling, partitioning, indexing strategies, and database scalability across high\-volume transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) environments. Drive the technical roadmap aligned with Citi's enterprise reference architectures, zero\-trust infrastructure, and microservices ecosystem.
* Modernization, DBaaS \& Cloud Enablement Lead migration initiatives from legacy on\-premises databases to modern cloud and containerized platforms (AWS RDS/Aurora, OpenShift, internal private cloud DBaaS/PaaS). Champion database containerization and modern provisioning frameworks, automating lifecycle management and cluster autoscaling. Partner with application development and cloud architecture teams to re\-platform and refactor applications for cloud\-native persistence layers.
* High Availability, Replication \& Scalability Engineering Architect, configure, and maintain robust High Availability (HA) topologies (e.g., Oracle Data Guard/Active Data Guard, Oracle RAC, PostgreSQL Streaming Replication / Patroni, MongoDB Replica Sets \& Sharded Clusters). Establish cross\-region and multi\-data\-center replication strategies to support 24/7/365 mission\-critical banking operations with minimal RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and zero RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
* Advanced Performance Engineering, Tuning \& Diagnostics Spearhead deep\-dive performance troubleshooting, query optimization, indexing reviews, execution plan analysis, and database profiling across production systems. Establish automated monitoring, telemetry, and observability frameworks (using Prometheus, Grafana, OEM, AppDynamics, and APM tools) to proactively detect anomalies, locking/blocking, and resource bottlenecks. Direct proactive capacity planning, I/O footprint optimization, and memory management across compute and storage tiers.
* Security, Vulnerability Management \& Access Control Enforce end\-to\-end database security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), data masking, tokenization, TLS encryption in\-transit, and privileged access controls. Drive automated security patching, configuration baseline compliance (CIS Benchmarks), and rapid remediation of vulnerabilities (CVEs), ensuring zero non\-compliant instances across the fleet. Integrate identity and credential workflows with enterprise secrets management tools (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk) and role\-based access control (RBAC).
* Database DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& CI/CD Champion Database DevOps practices by integrating schema migrations and database deployments into automated CI/CD pipelines (via Harness, Tekton, Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub). Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) playbooks and configuration scripts using Ansible, Terraform, and Python/Bash automation. Eliminate manual operational touchpoints through self\-service database provisioning and automated routine maintenance.
* Continuity of Business (COB) \& Disaster Recovery (DR) Own the disaster recovery framework for core database estates, designing and executing regular formal COB/DR failover drills. Define and maintain backup and restore strategies (RMAN, storage snapshots, point\-in\-time recovery) to safeguard data integrity against hardware failures, corruption, and site\-level disasters. Ensure comprehensive auditability and validation of backup retention policies aligned with financial regulatory standards.
* Governance, Risk, Audit \& Regulatory Compliance Serve as the primary database technical authority during internal and external audit reviews, regulatory examinations, and risk assessments. Ensure full compliance with Citi's Information Security policies, data sovereignty regulations (e.g., GDPR, local residency laws), and financial record retention mandates. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational readiness checklists.
* Technical Leadership, Mentorship \& Vendor Engagement Provide strong technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to senior engineers, database administrators, and offshore support teams. Collaborate closely with application squads, enterprise architects, site reliability engineers (SREs), and product owners to translate complex business requirements into robust database architectures. Liaise with major database software vendors (Oracle, EnterpriseDB, MongoDB, AWS) on product escalations, feature enhancements, and roadmaps.
* Required Qualifications, Experience \& Certifications Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Experience: 12\+ years of progressive experience in database engineering/administration, with at least 3\+ years in a lead or architect capacity within a large\-scale, enterprise financial services environment. Core Technical Competencies: In\-depth expertise in Oracle (19c/21c, RAC, Data Guard) and/or PostgreSQL (v12\+, Patroni, Connection Pooling). Strong working proficiency with NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Redis) and DBaaS architectures. Demonstrated hands\-on scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Ansible, or Terraform. Solid understanding of Linux kernel OS tuning, storage architectures (SAN/NAS/NVMe), and networking protocols. Certifications (Preferred): Certified Oracle Database Administrator / Specialist AWS Certified Database – Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect Professional PostgreSQL / EDB Certified Professional MongoDB Certified DBA Associate / Professional Key Leadership \& Soft Skills Proven track record of managing high\-impact technical incidents and driving root cause analysis (RCA) to conclusion. **Job Duties: Roles \& Responsibilities**
 Execute data validation queries to compare:
   

  

 Source (Yellowbricks / Informatica outputs) vs Target (Databricks / Snowflake / dbt outputs).
   

  

 Perform:
   

  

 Row\-count checks between source and target tables.
   

  

 Aggregate validations (sums, counts, averages, distinct counts, min/max).
   

  

 Sample and cell\-level comparisons for critical entities and fields.
   

  

 Validate schema consistency (data types, lengths, precision/scale, nullable fields, constraints).
   

  

 Log discrepancies, analyze patterns, and work with developers to support root\-cause analysis.
   

  

 Understand Informatica mappings and workflows and their expected outputs.
   

  

 Validate dbt models (staging, core, marts) on Snowflake against legacy Informatica outputs.
   

  

 Test Databricks notebooks/jobs that replicate Yellowbricks logic — ensuring correct transformations, joins, filters, and aggregations.
   

  

 Validate CDC / incremental loads: new, changed, and deleted records are handled correctly.
   

  

 Execute functional tests to verify correct application of business rules after migration.
   

  

 Perform regression testing for each migration wave to ensure that previously validated data and flows remain correct.
   

  

 Support integration testing across layers:
   

  

 Source → Databricks / Snowflake
   

  

 dbt → Snowflake → downstream reports or extracts
   

  

 Validate downstream outputs (if in scope): reports, extracts, or interfaces that consume migrated data.

 Minimum Skills Required: Experience
   

  

 2\-4 years of experience in Software Testing / QA, with at least 2\+ years in Data Warehouse / ETL testing.
   

  

 Practical experience in data migration / data platform modernization projects is strongly preferred.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

 Strong SQL skills for writing complex queries and validations (joins, aggregations, window functions, filters).
   

  

 Hands\-on experience testing on at least one data platform such as:
   

  

 Snowflake, Databricks, or other cloud DW/Big Data platforms – experience with Snowflake/Databricks is a plus.
   

  

 Exposure to Informatica (understanding mappings/workflows and expected outputs).
   

  

 Exposure to dbt or willingness to learn dbt\-based validations (model outputs, dbt test results).
   

  

 Good understanding of data warehouse concepts: facts/dimensions, SCDs, aggregations, grain, source\-to\-target mapping.
   

  

 Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, JIRA, TestRail, qTest).
   

  

 Experience with Excel or similar tools for managing validation results and reconciliation artifacts.
   

  

**Soft Skills**
 Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to validation.

Technical Lead – Apps Engineering TeamChennai, India
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior .NET Developer/Technical Lead with 10\+ years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering scalable enterprise applications using C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, and Microsoft Azure. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, Entity Framework Core, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure cloud services, CI/CD, and Agile development practices. This role requires excellent problem\-solving abilities, technical leadership, and the capability to manage multiple products while delivering high\-quality, secure, and maintainable software solutions. Experience with cloud\-native applications, event\-driven architecture, and modern authentication frameworks such as OAuth2\.0, JWT, Azure AD, or Keycloak will be an added advantage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, development, and deployment of high\-performance, scalable, and maintainable applications.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Efficiently manage context switching between multiple products, ensuring focus and productivity across diverse tasks and projects.
* Architect, design, and implement microservices\-based solutions using C\#, .NET Core \& .NET
* Develop data access solutions using Entity Framework Core.
* Apply design patterns (Factory, Singleton, Repository, etc.) to solve software design problems effectively.
* Optimize database performance and ensure efficient data access using SQL Server.
* Leverage Azure services, including AKS, App Service, and Azure Functions, to build cloud\-native applications.
* Manage containerized applications using Docker and orchestrate with Kubernetes.
* Implement and maintain event\-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, or similar tools.
* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs for secure and scalable communication between services, integrating with Swagger/OpenAPI for documentation and OAuth2\.0/OpenID connect for security.
* Conduct code reviews and provide technical mentorship to junior developers.
* Ensure adherence to Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and provide regular status updates on progress.


**Key Competencies \& Skills**
* Proficiency in C\# and .NET Core: Minimum 10 years of experience.
* Strong experience with SQL Server for database design, development, and optimization.
* Expertise in Entity Framework and Entity Framework Core for ORM and data access.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure services (AKS, App Service, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps).
* Proficiency in designing and developing microservices architecture, with experience in Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration.
* In\-depth knowledge of design patterns for scalable and maintainable code architecture.
* Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms with practical application experience.
* Experience in RESTful API design, with knowledge of Swagger/OpenAPI, OAuth2\.0, and JWT for API security.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks (e.g., xUnit, NUnit), and version control systems (Git, GitFlow).
* Strong context switching ability, with the capacity to manage multiple products and shift focus between tasks efficiently.


**Additional Skills:**
* Familiarity with nHibernate and OData for advanced data access techniques.
* Experience with Test\-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies.
* Understanding of Zeebe (workflow engine) and SignalR (real\-time web functionality).
* Proficiency in PowerShell for scripting and automation tasks.
* Familiarity with identity management systems such as Keycloak and Azure AD for authentication and authorization.

 The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst is a senior\-level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems, data quality controls, metadata management, and governance capabilities in coordination with Technology, Data Governance, Risk, and Business teams. The overall objective of this role is to lead technology solutions that enhance Data Quality, Data Governance, Metadata Management, and Data Lineage capabilities across critical business data assets.
   

  

 The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader responsible for driving data quality outcomes, implementing governance standards, managing issue remediation activities, and ensuring end\-to\-end data traceability to support business, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with business, data governance, risk, and technology teams to implement and enhance enterprise Data Quality, Data Governance, Metadata Management, and Data Lineage solutions.
* Lead the design, implementation, and monitoring of Data Quality controls, business rules, exception management processes, and remediation activities across critical data assets.
* Drive resolution of Data Quality concerns, exceptions, control gaps, and corrective action plans (CAPs) through effective issue management and stakeholder engagement.
* Collaborate with Data Owners, Data Stewards, Architects, and Development teams to ensure Critical Data Elements (CDEs) are appropriately governed and monitored.
* Support end\-to\-end data lineage capture, validation, traceability, metadata maintenance, and impact analysis across enterprise data flows.
* Analyze complex business and system processes to identify Data Quality risks and implement sustainable remediation solutions.
* Develop standards, governance processes, and reporting mechanisms to improve Data Quality monitoring and data management effectiveness.
* Drive automation and technology enhancements that improve Data Quality controls, lineage visibility, metadata management, and governance reporting.
* Provide subject matter expertise during regulatory reviews, audits, risk assessments, and control evaluations related to Data Governance and Data Quality.
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, architecture, applications, data platforms, and infrastructure integrate to accomplish business goals.
* Provide in\-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues, evaluate alternatives, and develop innovative solutions.
* Serve as advisor and mentor to developers and analysts, allocating work and providing technical guidance as necessary.

* Strong understanding of Data Governance, Metadata Management, Critical Data Elements (CDEs), Data Lineage, and Data Control frameworks.

* Proven ability to manage complex projects and drive outcomes across multiple stakeholder groups.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid role seeks a seasoned technical lead with seven to eleven years of experience in IBM mainframe utilities CICS VSAM JCL DB2 and Cobol responsible for guiding complex application development and maintenance. The role focuses on delivering stable secure and high performing systems that support core business processes and create reliable outcomes for clients and society.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive complex mainframe application design and development activities using Cobol DB2 CICS VSAM and IBM mainframe utilities to deliver stable and scalable business solutions that meet client expectations and organizational standards.
* Oversee end to end batch and online processing flows using JCL and CICS regions to ensure predictable performance robust error handling and timely completion of critical business jobs.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into detailed technical specifications that make optimal use of DB2 schemas VSAM files utilities and Cobol programs to support efficient data processing.
* Review existing Cobol and JCL components to identify optimization opportunities and implement code improvements that enhance runtime efficiency resource utilization and long term maintainability.
* Coordinate impact assessments for change requests by evaluating dependencies across DB2 objects VSAM datasets CICS transactions and scheduling chains to minimize risk of production disruptions.
* Perform detailed root cause analysis for incidents on mainframe applications by examining logs dumps and performance statistics to quickly restore service and implement durable corrective actions.
* Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders in a hybrid work model to clarify requirements communicate design choices and align technical solutions with broader enterprise architecture and compliance guidelines.
* Implement robust unit testing component testing and integration testing strategies for Cobol programs JCL streams and CICS transactions to improve quality and reduce defects in higher environments.
* Document technical solutions data flows operational procedures and recovery steps in a clear and structured manner so that support teams can efficiently manage day to day operations and incident resolution.
* Mentor less experienced engineers on mainframe development practices code review standards and troubleshooting techniques so that the team consistently delivers reliable and secure solutions.
* Engage in performance tuning activities across DB2 queries VSAM access patterns and batch schedules to reduce processing windows and support better service levels for business users.
* Coordinate implementation activities for releases in day shifts by preparing deployment plans rollback strategies and validation steps that ensure smooth and predictable production rollouts.
* Partner with quality and security teams to ensure that mainframe applications comply with internal controls audit requirements and secure coding practices that protect sensitive enterprise data.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying automation opportunities within IBM mainframe utilities job scheduling and monitoring to enhance productivity and reduce manual operational effort.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate strong hands on experience in Cobol programming JCL scripting and IBM mainframe utilities with a proven record of delivering complex enhancements and production support in large scale environments.
* Exhibit deep understanding of CICS concepts including transactions programs maps and resource definitions with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues impacting online user interactions.
* Show advanced skills in DB2 design SQL tuning and data modeling along with practical experience managing DB2 objects statistics and utilities in support of critical business applications.
* Display solid knowledge of VSAM including keyed and alternate indexes file organizations and access methods to design resilient and high performance data storage structures.
* Bring practical exposure to structured software development life cycles change management processes and defect tracking tools so that deliverables follow consistent quality and governance practices.
* Possess strong analytical and problem solving abilities with the capacity to investigate complex production issues assess options and recommend pragmatic solutions within tight timeframes.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non technical stakeholders in both written and spoken form enabling effective collaboration in a hybrid work setup without the need for frequent travel.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
**About Connected Vehicle Data Platform**
 At Ford, data is at the heart of our transformation towards becoming a technology\-driven mobility company. Connected Vehicle Data Platform's mission is to build foundational, company\-wide systems and processes designed to intelligently collect, manage, control, and democratize all vehicle\-related data as key data products. Its purpose is to eliminate data fragmentation and duplication, enabling robust cloud and vehicle data capabilities that facilitate proactive issue identification, reduce regulatory penalties, recalls, and warranty claims, and ensure global compliance for evolving data use cases, especially for 2026 MY\+ vehicles.
   

  

**Summary**
 We are seeking a visionary Principal Engineer to serve as the technical authority for our Connected Vehicle Data Platform(200\+ engineering org), with a specific focus on
 **AI\-driven data architecture** 
 . In this role, you will bridge the gap between Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Applied AI. You will drive the architectural vision for how we process massive streams of vehicle data and lead the implementation of
 **Agentic flows and AI agents** 
 to automate data collection, governance, and insight generation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a "player\-coach" who remains hands\-on in the code while providing high\-level technical leadership. You will be responsible for designing resilient streaming architectures that leverage the latest in AI/ML to ensure our 2026 MY\+ vehicle data is not just stored but intelligently utilized to drive proactive business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Grounds\-Up Streaming Re\-architecture: Lead the technical vision and execution for re\-building the connected vehicle streaming foundation. Replace legacy systems with a modern, high\-throughput, and low\-latency stack designed for global scale and efficiency.
* IC Leadership of Senior Talent: Act as the primary technical mentor and lead for the portfolio’s Staff and Senior Staff Engineers. Drive technical alignment across an 80\+ person engineering organization through RFCs, architecture reviews, and "Golden Path" implementations.
* Advanced Data Modeling: Define the standards for database and time\-series data modeling. Architect specialized schemas for high\-cardinality vehicle telemetry that balance high\-speed ingestion with cost\-effective, performant querying.
* Agentic Data Insights: Design and develop AI Agentic flows that revolutionize how Ford interacts with data. Move beyond static dashboards by building agents capable of autonomously "answering data questions" interpreting natural language queries to generate real\-time insights from billions of vehicle data points.
* AI\-Driven Efficiency: Architect systems where Applied AI/ML is used to drive massive efficiency gains. This includes intelligent data pruning, automated anomaly detection, and AI\-optimized compute resource allocation (GCP Dataflow/Dataproc).
* Agentic Data Collection: Develop autonomous agents for "Intelligent Ingestion," enabling self\-healing pipelines and automated metadata tagging to eliminate data fragmentation and ensure global compliance.
* Efficiency \& Cost Ownership: Lead the technical strategy for optimizing cloud unit economics. Drive architectural changes that significantly reduce the total cost of ownership (TCO) for vehicle data products while increasing reliability.


**Hands\-on Excellence:** 
 Maintain a high level of technical craft by prototyping the most difficult segments of the architecture and solving the portfolio’s most complex technical bottlenecks.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Education: Minimum – Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. Preferred – Master’s or PhD in a highly technical field.
* Experience:10\+ years of professional experience in software and data engineering, with a proven track record of architecting large\-scale (Petabyte\-scale) streaming and distributed systems.
* IC Leadership: Demonstrated experience as a Staff or Senior Staff Engineer (or equivalent) providing technical leadership for large organizations (50\-100\+ engineers).
* Modeling Expertise: Expert\-level knowledge of Database Modeling (Relational, NoSQL) and specialized Time\-Series Data Modeling (e.g., handling high\-frequency sensor data, windowing, and compaction).
* AI \& Agentic Mastery: Deep hands\-on experience in Applied AI, including the development of Agentic workflows (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI) and utilizing LLMs to automate data exploration and insight generation.
* Streaming \& Cloud Stack: Expert proficiency in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically BigQuery, Dataflow, and Vertex AI. Mastery of Kafka or Pub/Sub for high\-throughput messaging.
* Efficiency Mindset: Proven ability to re\-drive architectures specifically for efficiency gains, cost reduction, and performance optimization in a cloud\-native environment.
* Modern Engineering Standards: Mastery of SDLC, MLOps, and LLMOps, with the ability to set the standard for testing, observability, and deployment of AI\-integrated data systems.
* Technical Sovereignty: As the lead IC for the portfolio, you have the autonomy to re\-drive the foundation of Ford’s connected vehicle future.
* Scale \& Complexity: Work with one of the world's largest and most complex IoT datasets.
* Innovation: Lead the industry move from "Data Pipelines" to "Agentic Data Ecosystems."
* Impact: Directly influence the safety, compliance, and efficiency of the 2026 MY\+ vehicle fleet.
* Join Us in Re\-driving the Future of Automotive Data at Ford!

title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e\-Commerce products catalog. We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top\-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. We develop and apply technologies spanning parallel processing, storage, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Image Recognition.
   

  

 You will be part of Services Support Team under Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) in ASCS Org. The mission of the Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) team is to provide a single point of contact for item\-related problems and issues related to all retail and merchant catalog. As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1\-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross\-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross\-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code \& procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade\-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Big Picture: Solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
   

  

 Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
   

  

 Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.
   

  

 Quality: You demonstrate appropriate quality and thoroughness.
   

  

 Integrity: You act with personal integrity at all times
   

  

**About The Team**
 Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We own implementation of business logic and configurations for these services and systems. We increase selection by on\-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. We drive strategic cross\-functional programs that span across multiple catalog engineering teams
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C\+\+, C\#, Rust

description:
**Use Your Power for Purpose**
 At Pfizer, our Worldwide Medical and Safety colleagues are pivotal in bridging evidence\-based medical decision support with stakeholders to enhance health and treatment outcomes. Whether you are developing frameworks to ensure our evidence is scientifically robust, offering unbiased and medically essential expertise, or exploring ways to address data gaps, our mission remains clear: to empower healthcare decisions regarding the safe and appropriate use of medicines for patients. You will play a crucial role in improving patients' lives by ensuring the accuracy and integrity of clinical data. Your work will directly impact the development of new treatments and therapies, helping to bring innovative solutions to patients in need.
   

  

**What You Will Achieve**
* Engage in Data Monitoring and Management (DMM) activities, including data review, query management, and investigating logic check flags.
* Ensure the quality of database design through documentation, testing, validation, and implementation of clinical data collection tools or systems.
* Serve as the first Point of Contact for customers needing assistance with Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) questions and issues.
* Adhere to applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and working practices.
* Collaborate with Study Team Points of Contact, Document Owners, and Trial Master File (TMF) Study Owners to resolve document\-related discrepancies and issues.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives and additional projects as they arise.


**Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)**
* BA/BS with any years of experience
* Demonstrated experience of ICH/GCP (International Council for Harmonization/Good Clinical Practice) documentation requirements
* Hands\-on experience with electronic documentation management systems and/or web\-based data management systems
* Awareness of the clinical development process, including a deep understanding of the principles of Good Clinical Practice
* Solid grasp of regulatory requirements and relevant data standards
* Strong oral and written English communication skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite


**Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)**
* Experience with clinical trial management systems (CTMS)
* Familiarity with data validation and quality control processes
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

 The Junior BI Operations Engineer will assist in monitoring, maintaining, and reporting for 24x7 Enterprise BI operations and schedules. Working under the guidance of senior team members, you will support incident and problem management, ensure smooth execution of daily ETL pipelines, and help enable data across the enterprise for reporting.
   

  

 This role operates on a shift system as part of our global 24x7 BI Operations team. It is an ideal position for an early\-career engineer looking to build deep expertise in data warehousing, automated ETL operations, Python scripting, and AI\-driven workflows.

* ETL Scheduling \& Runbooks: Help prepare and maintain job scheduling modules; document and update runbooks with runtime statistics and operational steps.
* Knowledge Transfer: Participate in KT sessions with Data Engineering and Development teams for seamless handovers to the Ops environment.
* Automation \& Scripting: Support the automation of routine operational checks using Python, Shell scripting, and version control best practices via GitHub.
* AI\-Assisted Operations: Leverage modern AI and LLM tools to assist in log analysis, query optimization, bug fixing, and process documentation.

**Key Qualifications**
****Required Skills \& Experience:****
* Experience: 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in BI, Data Operations, L1/L2 Support, or Data Engineering.
* Database \& SQL: Foundational to working knowledge of SQL, PL/SQL, and relational database concepts.
* Data Warehousing: Basic understanding of data warehousing concepts (e.g., dimensional modeling, staging, star schema).
* Scripting \& Programming: Hands\-on experience or working knowledge of Python and Unix/Linux Shell scripting for automation tasks.
* Version Control: Familiarity with GitHub or Git workflows for code repository management and version tracking.
* AI \& LLMs: Basic knowledge or practical exposure to AI \& Large Language Model (LLM) tools (e.g., using LLM assistants for code debugging, prompt\-assisted scripting, or log pattern detection).

* Support \& Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a willingness to learn root\-cause analysis and bug fixing.
* Shift Work: Willingness to work in shifts within a 24x7 operational rotation.

* Hands\-on experience with Pentaho Data Integration (PDI) scheduling.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts applied to data pipelines.
* Familiarity with ticketing tools like Jira, ServiceNow, or similar ITSM platforms.

title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
description:
**About Gen**
 Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award\-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.
   

  

 Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high\-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.
   

  

 When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well\-being programs.
   

  

 At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Data Engineering to serve as a technical people leader responsible for owning the deliverables of your team and going the distance to empower them to achieve their objectives. You can expect to be architecting systems within your team's domain and driving complex, cross\-team projects that directly support our cybersecurity platform's strategic objectives. This role requires someone who can architect systems within your team's domain, reasonably be expected to come up with and drive the projects that your crew should do to solve complex business problems.
   

  

 As a Senior Manager, Data Engineering, you are expected to manage your time between Individual Contributor (IC) hands\-on\-keyboard coding, PR reviewing and managing your team across its entire domain. You are expected to participate, contribute and improve the hiring process and be an active champion of the org’s cross\-geographical RFC \& Technical Specification review process.
   

  

 Above all, you will be an authority on crafting thoughtful solutions that will empower absolutely everyone at Gen Digital towards an agentic AI\-first analytics and development lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the people management responsibilities of a team of driven Data Engineers – including performance \& compensation management, hiring and mentorship.
* Extensive expertise operating \& optimizing a modern data warehousing solution (Snowflake preferred) from both performance and cost perspectives.
* Expertise with Apache Kafka, real\-time data processing, and event\-driven architectures
* Experience with Apache Iceberg, data lakehouse architectures, and modern table formats
* Design and architect enterprise\-scale data solutions that directly impact Gen's data strategy execution. Contribute a minimum of 1 exemplary technical spec per year that massively moves Gen’s data architecture forward.
* Lead evaluation and implementation of cutting\-edge technologies including modern data stack and advanced analytics
* Collaborate with executives and senior leadership to align data architecture with business strategy and manage senior stakeholders from external departments
* Drive complex, multi\-quarter technical initiatives requiring coordination across multiple engineering teams


**About You**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or related technical field
* 5\-10 years of hands\-on data engineering experience in large\-scale, high\-volume environments, with 1\-2 years of management experience
* Expert\-level proficiency in SQL optimization for multi\-petabyte datasets and advanced Python programming
* Extensive experience with Snowflake architecture, optimization, and cost management at enterprise scale
* Demonstrated expertise building Kimball dimensional data warehouses and star schema architectures
* Advanced experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and either DBT or SQLMesh for data transformations
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitFlow, and data governance frameworks ensuring GDPR/PCI\-DSS compliance
* Familiarity with AWS is a big plus
* Experience in planning day to day tasks, knowing how and what to prioritise and overseeing their execution
* Experience working with PMO, other data specialities (analysts, scientists, machine learning), and working across time zones.


**What's Next**
* TA Call
* Technical Screening \- PR Review Exercise
* Technical Screening \- Focused on Snowflake and Dimensional Modeling
* Hiring Manager Interview \- Whiteboarding Design Round
* Bar Raiser Round


**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**
 Gen is an
 **equal opportunity employer** 
 , and we’re committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

title: Associate Architect
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
 At Presidio, we’re at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting\-edge digital solutions and next\-generation AI. We empower businesses—and their customers—to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
   

  

**The Role**
**Strategic Ownership \& Leadership**
* Own and manage the cloud ecosystem across AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring they operate with high efficiency, strong governance, and predictable costs.
* Lead a small team of cloud engineers, guiding and coaching them in roadmap creation, prioritization, execution, and skills development.
* Act as a strategic advisor to engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders on sandbox governance, usage patterns, and optimization strategies.
* Establish and enforce policies for onboarding, offboarding, resource lifecycle, and access management for users.


**Operational Excellence \& Automation**
* Design and implement automation for sandbox provisioning, quota management, access approval workflows, scheduling, and spin\-up/spin\-down processes.
* Develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Cloud\-native tools) for repeatable lab operations.\[MS1]
* Create self\-service capabilities and guardrails for sandbox users to reduce manual effort and improve governance.
* Collaborate on lab, demo, and proof of concept engagements with internal and external stakeholders.


**FinOps, Cost Governance \& Optimization**
* Implement a FinOps\-aligned operating model for all accounts including tagging standards, cost allocation, budget enforcement, and showback/chargeback across all clouds.
* Continuously analyze cloud spend trends, forecast usage, and proactively identify opportunities for rightsizing, decommissioning, and efficiency improvements.
* Build automation for policy\-based cleanup of unused/idle resources.


**Security, Governance \& Compliance**
* Define and implement security guardrails, baseline configurations, identity/access rules, and monitoring policies for sandbox environments.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance controls and enforce boundaries between sandbox and production environments.
* Implement monitoring dashboards, alerts, and operational metrics to ensure visibility and control.


**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively introduce new approaches, tools, and technologies to make lab and demo operations more efficient, secure, and cost\-effective.
* Conduct periodic reviews of account usage patterns to identify opportunities for consolidation, automation, or architectural improvements.
* Partner with cloud providers, vendors, and internal teams to evaluate new services and establish best practices.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or cloud operations roles, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or team lead position.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and working knowledge of the other two.
* Demonstrated experience in managing large or multi\-tenant cloud environments, including governance, account/projects/subscription management.
* Strong automation experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Understanding of Cloud Networking Concepts, such as AWS VPCs, Transit Gateways, Azure VNets, Public DNS with AWS Route 53 and VPN tunnel creation from the hyperscaler side.
* Familiarity with Cloud Compute and Storage such as EC2 Instances, Azure Virtual Machines, Google Compute Engine, AWS S3/EBS/EFS and/or Azure Disk Storage
* Proven expertise in FinOps, cloud cost governance, and optimization frameworks.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, guardrails, monitoring, and policy management.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications: AWS Solutions Architect / Azure Architect Expert / GCP Professional Cloud Architect.
* Prior experience in managing demo or lab environments, platform engineering, or multi\-cloud landing zones.
* Experience with cost analytics tools (CloudHealth, Flexera, Cloud Custodian, Kubecost, native cost tools).
* Knowledge of container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD workflows.
* Exposure to Cloud Centers of Excellence (CCoE) or platform engineering teams.


**Your future at Presidio**
 Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers—thinkers, builders, and collaborators—who push the boundaries of what’s possible. With our expertise in AI\-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next\-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data\-driven transformation, you’ll be part of a team that is shaping the future.
   

  

**Ready to innovate? Let’s redefine what’s next—together.**
**About Presidio**
 At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades\-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio’s expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, enables actionable data insights and builds forward\-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally.
 **For more information, visit www.presidio.com** 
**.**
 Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.
   

  

***Recruitment Agencies, Please Note:***
 Presidio does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email address, Presidio employees or any other means. Presidio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.
