title: Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
description:
**Job Description** 
 – Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
 



**Position** 
 : Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
 



**Experience** 
 : 12\+ Years
 



**Role Level:** 
 Architect / Lead SME
 



**Location** 
 : Chennai
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Oracle OCI Exadata Architect with strong hands\-on expertise in designing, administering and supporting enterprise Oracle database environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
 



 The candidate must have strong experience with OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D), Exadata VM Clusters, Oracle Database 19c/23ai, RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, Exadata patching, performance tuning, OCI networking and disaster recovery.
 



 This is a hands\-on Architect/Lead SME role requiring strong technical leadership and the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Architect, administer and support OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D).
 



 • Provision, configure and manage Exadata Infrastructure and Exadata VM Clusters.
 



 • Manage Exadata compute, memory, storage, database servers and storage servers, including capacity planning and resource optimization.
 



 • Plan and execute Exadata Infrastructure, VM Cluster, Grid Infrastructure and Database RU patching, including pre\-checks, validation and rollback planning.
 



 • Administer and troubleshoot Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, SCAN, VIP, listeners and database services.
 



 • Support Oracle Database 19c and 23ai, including patching, upgrades and migration activities.
 



 • Design and support Data Guard / Active Data Guard, RMAN backup/recovery and DR solutions.
 



 • Monitor and troubleshoot Exadata Storage Servers, cell services, flash/cache, I/O and database performance.
 



 • Perform performance analysis and tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor and Exadata performance metrics.
 



 • Perform regular health checks, capacity reviews, proactive monitoring and performance assessments.
 



 • Lead troubleshooting and RCA for critical P1/P2 production incidents and coordinate with Oracle Support for critical SRs.
 



 • Support database and workload migrations from on\-premises or other Oracle platforms to OCI Exadata.
 



 • Work closely with Oracle DBA, EBS Apps DBA, OCI, middleware, network and security teams.
 



**OCI Infrastructure \& Networking** 




 Strong working knowledge of OCI infrastructure supporting Exadata environments, including:
 



 VCN \& Subnets \| Client \& Backup Networks \| NSGs \| Security Lists \| Route Tables \| DRG \| DNS/SCAN \| FastConnect \| Site\-to\-Site VPN \| OCI IAM \| Vault/KMS \| OCI Monitoring \| Alarms \| Object Storage \| TDE
 



 The candidate should be capable of troubleshooting application\-to\-database, RAC, on\-premises\-to\-OCI and network latency/connectivity issues.
 



**Required Technical Skills** 




 OCI Exadata / ExaDB\-D \| Exadata VM Clusters \| Oracle Database 19c \& 23ai \| Oracle RAC \| Grid Infrastructure \| ASM \| Data Guard \| RMAN \| Exadata Patching \| AWR/ASH \| Performance Tuning \| OCI Networking \| Linux \| Backup \& Recovery \| DR \| Database Migration \| Patching \& Upgrades
 



 Experience supporting large enterprise Oracle database environments is required.
 



 Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2 running on OCI Exadata will be an added advantage.
 



**Preferred Certifications** 




 Relevant Oracle certifications are preferred, particularly:
 



 • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
 



 • Oracle Cloud Database Services Professional
 



 • Oracle Database Administration OCP / Professional
 



 • Relevant Oracle Database 23ai certification
 



 • Relevant Oracle Exadata, OCI Networking, Security or Migration certifications
 



**Candidate Profile** 




 The candidate should be a hands\-on OCI Exadata Architect / Lead SME, not limited to architecture or OCI networking.
 



 Strong experience in Exadata administration, VM Cluster management, Exadata patching, RAC/ASM, performance troubleshooting and production operations is essential.
 



 The role requires strong communication, customer\-facing, troubleshooting and documentation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, production incidents, architecture reviews, migrations, patching and performance optimization in an enterprise managed\-services environment.

description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid night shift role focuses on managing product information and master data to support efficient order management and trading operations for an MNC. The SME will optimize data flows between systems ensure accuracy of product and order records and collaborate with cross functional teams to improve retail order processes. The role contributes directly to customer satisfaction and stable trading performance by maintaining reliable data foundations and supporting continuous improvement a
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end ownership of product information and master data flows for order management and trading systems ensuring accurate synchronized data across core platforms to support consistent execution and reliable reporting
* Manage creation update and maintenance of product master records including attributes hierarchies pricing and availability so that downstream order and trading processes operate with clean structured data
* Coordinate closely with order management operations teams to analyze data issues impacting order capture fulfillment and settlement and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence and reduce manual interventions
* Collaborate with trading and commercial stakeholders to define data rules for item setup bundle management and promotional constructs ensuring that business strategies are reflected reliably in system configurations
* Monitor nightly data loads and interface jobs across hybrid environments addressing exceptions in near real time to secure uninterrupted processing and timely visibility for global teams
* Design and maintain data quality checks and validation routines that detect anomalies in product and order data enabling early remediation and continuous improvement of master data standards
* Document functional data models for order management and trading processes translating complex concepts into clear reference materials that support onboarding and knowledge sharing across teams
* Partner with technology teams to refine mapping logic between product information management master data management and order platforms focusing on performance scalability and resilience of integrations
* Support incident analysis for data related defects in night shift operations providing structured root cause insights and proposing pragmatic solutions that enhance customer experience and operational stability
* Contribute to process optimization initiatives across retail order flows by proposing enhancements to data structures configuration rules and workflows that reduce cycle times and improve order accuracy
* Engage with stakeholders in hybrid working sessions to gather requirements for new product and order data capabilities and convert them into well defined specifications that guide implementation and testing
* Perform impact assessments for product and master data changes across reporting billing and trading processes ensuring that dependencies are understood and that transitions are executed safely without disruption
* Promote adoption of master data governance practices through clear communication of standards guidance on best practices and active participation in forums that strengthen data discipline across the organization


**Qualifications**
* Possess four to seven years of hands on experience as a subject matter expert in product information and master data within complex order management and trading environments demonstrating strong ownership of data outcomes
* Bring solid practical expertise working with core order management platforms and trading systems including configuration troubleshooting and data analysis to keep high volume operations running smoothly
* Apply demonstrated exposure to retail order management scenarios such as omnichannel ordering and inventory visibility translating domain understanding into better data design and process alignment
* Show capability in documenting requirements user stories and data dictionaries in a clear and structured manner making it easier for cross functional teams to deliver enhancements and maintain solutions
* Demonstrate strong analytical skills using data profiling and issue analysis techniques to identify root causes of product and order data problems and to recommend sustainable corrective actions
* Operate effectively in a hybrid work model and dedicated night shift environment maintaining proactive communication and coordination with onshore and offshore partners without needing travel
* Exhibit familiarity with master data management principles including governance stewardship and lifecycle management applying them to improve reliability and reusability of product and order data assets

**Job Description** 




 Enterprise Platform Administrator / Consultant – ServiceNow \& Salesforce
 



 Position Overview
 



 We are looking for an
 **Enterprise Platform Administrator / Consultant** 
 with hands\-on knowledge of
 **ServiceNow and Salesforce** 
 to configure, administer, automate, integrate, and continuously improve enterprise service management and customer operations platforms.
 



 The successful candidate will work across both platforms, translating business requirements into scalable configurations, workflows, integrations, and governed platform solutions. The role requires a strong understanding of
 **IT Service Management (ITSM), CRM, platform administration, automation, scripting, data security, integration, testing, and release management** 
 .
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ServiceNow Administration \& Configuration
 


* Administer and configure ServiceNow instances, including tables, forms, lists, roles, groups, ACLs, notifications, and scoped applications.
* Configure and support ITSM processes including:
* Incident Management
* Problem Management
* Change Enablement
* Request Fulfilment
* Service Level Management
* Work with the CMDB and Common Service Data Model to maintain service\-aware processes.
* Configure UI and data policies, client scripts, business rules, notifications, and other platform components.
* Develop and maintain ServiceNow applications using Studio and App Engine Studio.
* Build workflows and automations using Flow Designer and IntegrationHub.
* Configure Service Catalog items, record producers, approvals, and Virtual Agent topics.
* Develop and troubleshoot server\-side scripts using GlideRecord and related ServiceNow APIs.
* Create and consume REST APIs and work with Import Sets and Transform Maps.



 Salesforce Administration \& Development
 


* Configure Salesforce objects, fields, record pages, relationships, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and field\-level security.
* Design scalable Salesforce data models using lookup, master\-detail, and junction relationships.
* Build business automation using Salesforce Flow Builder.

title: SAP SD
description:
**Job Summary**
 GeoSpatial Analyst MAP with extensive expertise in SAP SD Testing and SAP SD will analyze complex geographic and sales distribution data to enhance supply chain performance in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on optimizing routes territories and order fulfillment processes collaborating across business and technology teams to drive efficient consumer goods distribution and support strategic decision making.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze spatial data from enterprise systems to derive actionable insights that optimize sales distribution patterns and supply chain flows across diverse geographic regions ensuring efficient product availability for customers and stakeholders.
* Design and maintain geospatial models that integrate SAP SD transactional data with location intelligence to improve order routing delivery planning and regional demand forecasting for business units.
* Collaborate with SAP SD testers and business analysts to validate end to end data flows between geospatial solutions and SAP SD modules ensuring accuracy of pricing delivery and customer master information across markets.
* Develop and refine reusable test scenarios and data sets for SAP SD Testing that incorporate geospatial attributes enabling robust validation of territory assignments shipping conditions and logistic routes.
* Evaluate complex supply chain processes for consumer goods using map based analytics identifying bottlenecks in transportation warehousing and last mile delivery and recommending data driven improvements.
* Create detailed dashboards and map visualizations that present key performance indicators related to order fulfillment regional sales performance and supply chain disruptions in formats that are easy for business teams to interpret.
* Coordinate with demand planning distribution and customer service teams to ensure geospatial analysis aligns with real world constraints such as service level expectations inventory positioning and carrier capacities.
* Document geospatial analysis methods data transformations and SAP SD Testing approaches in clear technical narratives that support audit readiness knowledge transfer and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assess the impact of new business rules and configuration changes in SAP SD on geospatial models recommending updates to algorithms and data structures that preserve consistency and reliability of insights.
* Automate data extraction and quality checks for geospatial and SAP SD data sources using approved tools reducing manual effort and increasing timeliness of reporting for supply chain and commercial stakeholders.
* Support continuous enhancement of hybrid work practices by enabling secure remote access to geospatial tools maintaining performance standards for map rendering and ensuring responsive collaboration with onsite teams.
* Participate in cross functional workshops to translate strategic supply chain goals into geospatial use cases prioritizing initiatives that improve sustainability reduce waste and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Provide thought guidance on emerging trends in geoanalytics and digital supply chain proposing practical pilots that use existing SAP SD and mapping capabilities to create measurable business impact.


**Qualifications**
* Bring strong experience in SAP SD Testing with deep understanding of order to cash pricing delivery processing and data integrity concepts applied to complex enterprise landscapes.
* Demonstrate advanced practical knowledge of SAP SD configuration and processes including customer master data material listings shipping conditions and billing flows relevant to geospatial analysis.
* Apply proven expertise in supply chain management to interpret logistics networks service levels and inventory strategies translating them into meaningful geospatial models and metrics.
* Offer solid exposure to consumer goods supply chains including channel structures promotion driven demand variation and distribution patterns that influence geospatial optimization opportunities.
* Utilize strong skills in geospatial data analysis and mapping tools to manage large spatial data sets perform proximity and route analyses and present insights in clear visual narratives.
* Employ disciplined testing and documentation practices including test case design defect tracking and root cause analysis ensuring that geospatial and SAP SD solutions meet quality expectations.
* Communicate effectively with technical and business partners synthesizing complex spatial and SAP SD information into transparent explanations that support informed decision making.


**Certifications Required**
 SAP SD certification plus any recognized geospatial or GIS analytics certification such as ESRI or equivalent.

title: Senior Oracle GoldenGate Data Replication Engineer / Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Oracle GoldenGate Data Replication Engineer / Architect to design, implement, and support real\-time and near real\-time data replication and CDC solutions using Oracle GoldenGate Microservices Architecture and Oracle GoldenGate Big Data Adapters.
   

  

 The role will focus on homogeneous and heterogeneous replication across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data platforms, with particular emphasis on Oracle and SQL Server migrations to Snowflake using Oracle GoldenGate Big Data DAA Adapters.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement enterprise\-grade Oracle GoldenGate replication, CDC, and migration architectures.
* Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and administer Oracle GoldenGate Microservices components, including Extract, Replicat, Distribution Service, Receiver Service, Service Manager, trails, checkpoints, and credential stores.
* Configure Oracle GoldenGate Big Data Adapters and DAA connectors for Snowflake, BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data lake integrations.
* Implement initial load, continuous synchronization, and CDC MERGE patterns for migrations into Snowflake.
* Support homogeneous and heterogeneous replication across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud platforms.
* Monitor replication latency, throughput, and availability; troubleshoot capture, delivery, trail, and performance issues.
* Prepare architecture diagrams, technical designs, deployment standards, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Support migration planning, cutover, rollback, incident resolution, and production support activities.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Oracle GoldenGate implementation, administration, and production support experience.
* Strong expertise in Oracle GoldenGate 19c, 21c, and 23ai, including Microservices Architecture, Integrated Extract, Classic Extract, Integrated Replicat, Parallel Replicat, Coordinated Replicat, and Big Data Adapters.
* Experience with Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong understanding of CDC, heterogeneous replication, data migration, high availability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Snowflake ingestion patterns including stage\-based loading, continuous replication, and MERGE\-based CDC processing.
* Good knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, data lake, and Lakehouse architecture concepts.
* Strong Linux/Unix administration, shell scripting, SQL, Python, and automation skills.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 A senior data integration specialist capable of leading enterprise CDC and migration initiatives using Oracle GoldenGate Microservices Architecture and Big Data DAA Connectors, with a strong focus on secure, scalable, high\-availability replication into Snowflake and other modern analytics platforms.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai / Bangalore \- India
   

  

 Work Model \- Hybrid
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to Help customer transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role, and it is not a features team. It is a Multi deployment unit embedded, operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.
   

  

 This team operates as a POD inside Kinaxis — a small, tight unit with end\-to\-end ownership and a startup mentality inside a larger company. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self\-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.
   

  

 You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers — from warehouse floor to executive sponsor — designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed.
   

  

 💡 Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught — but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Build the data backbone for AI Agents on Maestro**
* Design, build, and operate production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — that feed agentic AI workflows on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform.
* Integrate customer data sources (ERP systems, data warehouses, supply chain applications, flat files, APIs) into a unified data layer that agents can reason over reliably.
* Build and maintain data platform services, tooling, and infrastructure that enable reliable data ingestion, processing, sharing, and discovery across customer deployments.
* Own data quality end\-to\-end: profiling, validation, anomaly detection, and lineage — because an agent is only as good as the data behind it.


**Ship AI Agents alongside the POD**
* Partner with AI\-focused FDEs to design, develop, and ship agentic AI workflows — including multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and tool\-use patterns — ensuring the data layer is production\-ready.
* Translate messy, real\-world customer data landscapes into clean, well\-modeled foundations that agents can consume — iterating rapidly from prototype to deployment.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack data pipelines, model context, API layers, and infrastructure — in live customer environments.


**Own the full solution lifecycle**
* Carry multiple customer engagements in parallel; set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when priorities shift, and own outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Define and track success in business terms: data freshness SLAs, pipeline reliability, query performance, exception rates — not just deployment completion.
* Drive platform engineering best practices through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD automation, observability, and automated testing across customer deployments.


**Work inside a POD team**
* Operate as part of a small, self\-directed POD within Kinaxis tasks traded fluidly to whoever has the right skills, focus maintained with urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings and repeatable data patterns into durable platform capabilities, not one\-off scripts.
* Serve as the technical face of the team in customer rooms — from IC\-level engineers to skeptical architects to VP sponsors and build genuine trust across all of them.


**Drive adoption and change**
* Guide customer data teams through solution transitions: the new data architecture has to stick, not just ship.
* Mentor customer teams on modern data engineering practices, agentic data workflows, and new operating patterns so capability transfers and does not remain dependent on you.


****What we are looking for****
**Bias to action**
 You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours — no waiting for perfect clarity.
   

  

**Self\-directed**
 You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver — without being told.
   

  

**Always learning**
 Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
   

  

**Customer\-obsessed**
 You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst — and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
   

  

**Comfortable with ambiguity**
 Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric — and you still ship.
   

  

**Drives change, not just code**
 You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
   

  

 The following are the technical areas we look for. You do not need depth in all of them — we look for strong foundations, a growth trajectory, and the ability to pick up what is missing quickly.
   

  

**Data Engineering \& Platforms (Primary)**
* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning at scale.
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of data modeling, schema design, and large\-scale data processing patterns.
* Experience with data governance practices: RBAC, PII handling, data lineage, data quality frameworks, and enterprise\-scale data management.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar).
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments — you have untangled broken pipelines at 2 AM and lived to tell the tale.


**AI \& Agentic Development**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications — RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
* Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns — when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.


**Software Engineering**
* Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
* Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.


**Data Engineering \& Platforms**
* Ability to build and maintain data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals.
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments.


**Supply Chain Domain (Nice to Have)**
* Prior exposure to supply chain planning, logistics, or operations domains is a genuine plus — not a requirement.
* Experience with or curiosity about platforms like Kinaxis, SAP IBP, o9, or Blue Yonder is welcome context.


**Experience \& Background**
* 3 – 6 years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, software engineering, or a technical\-founder role. Strong candidates at either end of that range are welcome to apply.
* Prior exposure to customer\-facing technical roles — solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats — is a strong signal, though not a requirement.


**How You Will Succeed In This Role**
* You measure your own success in business outcomes — efficiency gains, exception reduction, SLA improvements — not lines of code shipped.
* You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities.
* You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end\-to\-end without requiring close supervision.
* You are curious and pragmatic — you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new.
* You communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business stakeholders — written, verbal, and in the room.


**\#Fulltime, \#Full\-time** 
**\#Associate**
**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
   

  

 Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

* Validate cross\-platform financial flows (e.g., time → project costing → revenue recognition; expenses → AP postings; forecasts → Adaptive).
* Serve as primary liaison with software vendors for escalations, service tickets, and system enhancements.
* Review vendor release notes, assess impacts, and coordinate testing.
* Identify and implement workflow improvements (e.g., Replicon time accuracy, Concur T\&E automation, Rillion AP automation).
* Ensure cross\-system alignment of financial data, project structures, customers, vendors, GL accounts, and cost centers.
* Support financial reporting and planning cycles by ensuring accurate data flow into Adaptive.
* Conduct training, create job aids, and maintain documentation for processes and system changes.
* Lead cross\-functional sessions to gather business requirements and translate into systems configurations.
* Utilize SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and APIs for seamless data exchange.
* Drive automation and process improvements across financial workflows.
* Monitor system performance and proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Manage user access and security policies to safeguard system integrity.
* Document system configurations and procedures for future reference and compliance.
* Provide user support and training to ensure effective system utilization.
* Lead system audits and compliance checks to meet regulatory requirements.
* Implement new SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem modules and features to enhance system capabilities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems with other business applications.
* Develop and execute system improvement plans to optimize performance and efficiency.
* Monitor all upcoming changes being deployed by SAP. Work on testing plans and keeping senior staff updated on upcoming changes.
* Understand downstream impacts of changes including hot fixes. Create impact summary and review with leadership.
* Execute UAT and tasks for Upgrades, Mergers and Acquisitions, Vendor Coordination, and other associated projects.
* Monitor and troubleshoot SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem integrations.
* Serve as backup to other team members to backfill during peak periods, PTO, etc.


**Qualifications**
* At least 3 to 5 years’ experience with SAP S/4 Hana Public Cloud with a focus on financial accounting or professional service organizations.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field to ensure foundational knowledge.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to address system issues effectively.
* Experience supporting financial systems such as Replicon, Concur, Unanet, Adaptive, or similar platforms.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate with various stakeholders. Experience working in a global team environment.
* Experience with integration technologies (CPI, REST APIs, SFTP).
* Financial Knowledge
* Strong grasp of accounting principles and financial processes.
* Ability to map business requirements to SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud solutions.
* In\-depth knowledge of data management to ensure data integrity.
* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud certification to validate expertise.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet business demands.
* Lead meetings by setting clear objectives, driving focused and collaborative discussion, and ensuring accountability for timely completion of action items.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.


**Required Knowledge And Skills**
* Comprehensive knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud architecture to understand system components.
* Working knowledge and subject matter expertise in one or more SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud functional areas, including FICO, Order\-to\-Cash (OTC), Project Systems (PS), Security, and/or system integrations. Proficiency in system monitoring and performance tuning to maintain optimal operation.
* Working proficiency with financial systems such as Replicon, Concur, Unanet, Rillion, Adaptive Planning.
* Advanced scripting skills (e.g., Bash, PowerShell) to automate tasks. (preferred)
* Strong understanding of user access and security management to protect system integrity.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex issues. This includes what is an incident versus what is a defect.
* Expertise in data management systems (e.g., S4 Hana Public Cloud transport management) to manage data effectively.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies to lead system improvement initiatives i.e., SAP Activate.

* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud for enterprise resource planning.
* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Fiori for user interface and experience.
* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud GUI for system access and management.
* Windows and Microsoft Office Suite operating systems for diverse environments. Cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) for scalable infrastructure.

title: External Data Services Manager
description:
ICON plc is a world\-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.
   

  

 Job Advert Posting
   

  

 As an External Data Services Manager at ICON, you will be instrumental in leading the development and implementation of advanced data science solutions for clinical trials.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 You will manage day\-to\-day clinical data science activities, supporting your team to deliver quality outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Lead the development of Data Transfer Specifications (DTS) documents to align external data providers and research partners on the required structure for new data. This includes:
* Authoring the DTS, responding to external data providers and internal stakeholder queries to ensure
* data will be delivered in the correct format and structure.
* Track DTS status with external data providers across different data types and programs and ensure data completion dates are met for study timelines and deliverables.
* Ensuring data structure based on the type(s) of data being used is consistent and compliant with appropriate data templates.
* Ensuring data structure is consistent across each data provider and comply with appropriate data templates.
* Support data reconciliation and data structure inquiry resolution.
* Liaise cross functionally to facilitate the creation of new test codes.
* Participate in the Clinical Study Team as an extended team member.
* Oversee and train in the use of the DTS and other supplemental documents.
* Contribute to improvement initiatives as it relates to external data process.
* Ensure study teams adhere to CDISC standards as it relates to external data.
* Comply with all pertinent regulatory agency requirements (Understand clinical protocols and requirement for Biomarkers/Imaging/eCOA data, blinding and analysis expectations).
* Process change requests to update existing DTS.
* Improve templates for existing DTS to ensure data harmonization and downstream analytics.
* Provide external data management oversight to vendors, providing a pathway for functional discussions, partnership level processes \& standards, portfolio status, communication, and escalation.
* Review and contribute to eCRF and EDC builds as it relates to external data requirements.


**Your Profile**
 You will have solid clinical data science experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Minimum 8\+ years of experience in external data services
* Expertise in biomarker data types and/or Imaging data for oncology and non\-oncology studies is preferred
* Experience working with multiple data types/formats
* Experience in managing clinical, biomarker data, eCOA and imaging data
* Demonstrates broad knowledge of all applicable regulations including 21 CFR
* Part 11, ICH\-GCP Guidelines and CDISC standards for data collections.
* Demonstrates advanced knowledge of Data Management processes and industry best practices.
* Advanced knowledge and experience with extracting data into SAS, CSV, and
* XML formats is required.
